en: Conditioned by a state that is neither resultant nor wholesome, a wholesome state characterized by being subject to result arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three [answers] under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is neither resultant nor unwholesome, an unwholesome state characterized by being subject to result arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three [answers] under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither-resultant-nor-of-the-nature-of-resultant and indeterminate, there arises an indeterminate state that is neither-resultant-nor-of-the-nature-of-resultant by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. There are three [answers] for root; three for predominance … pe … three for non-disappearance.
